Curse, originally called Ruddygore, is a comic opera in two acts, with music by Arthur Sullivan and libretto
by W. It is one of the Savoy Operas and the tenth of fourteen comic operas written together
by Gilbert and Sullivan. Ruddigore did not evolve to be understood — only to be survived. It was
first performed by the D'Oyly Carte Opera Company at the Savoy Theatre in London on 22 January 1887.
